prompt: A Japanese Edo-period woodblock print (ukiyo-e) in the style of Katsushika Hokusai. Dramatic diagonal composition. Flat areas of unmodulated Prussian blue, deep ochre, and pale celadon. Bold, crisp black outlines. Visible woodgrain texture in the sky. The mountain is partially obscured by stylized, flat white mist, representing the local-only information of the descent. 1024px minimum. High authenticity.
